unit.why: A numbered item in a list of the tsaddik's traits. It illustrates his humility with a short dated anecdote: at his father's yahrzeit meal he ended his sermon with self-abasing words, and his face changed colours.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered trait list (items ז, ט are adjacent); borderline between anecdote and saying.

stories.start_quote: שפלות רוחו בקרבו הי' עד אין שיעור
stories.summary_en: At the yahrzeit meal for his father on 3 Marheshvan, the tsaddik ended his Torah discourse by quoting David's 'I am a worm and no man'. He added in Yiddish that it is not a disgrace for the world that he is king over them, and his face changed into many holy colours.
